title: ImprovingVanilla
description: Trying to improve the vanilla game's experience with some mods.
body:
# What's Inside?

This is a Minecraft modpack built on Neoforge. Its goal is to add useful features and optimizations without altering the core gameplay. Special thanks to all the optimization mods (like Sodium, Lithium, Ferritecore) and utility mods (like Chat Heads, Simple Voice Chat, No Chat Reports) that helped us build this pack! This modpack uses these mods as much as possible while prioritizing compatibility. It has been tested on Windows devices and runs well (more test results will come soon).

## Familiar Experience

The modifications are implemented with minimal changes to vanilla features, meaning you can easily pick it up and play, even if you've never used this modpack before—just as before.

## Vanilla Compatibility

Want to play with friends who are still using vanilla? Don't worry, you can connect without them needing to install the same modpack. Whether on a server or via LAN, you'll still have nearly all the modpack's features.

## Update Safely

When you update the modpack, the internally provided mods will continue to work normally. No need to worry about game corruption after updating!

## Built on Neoforge

This modpack is based on Neoforge, a popular mod loader known for performance optimization and supporting innovative gameplay. You can add your own mods to it!

## Open Development

Our development process thrives on your suggestions and support. Your feedback is our driving force. If you encounter any issues you'd like us to resolve, please feel free to contact us.

---

## Q&A

**Q: How do I download, install, and run it?**
**A:** Most launchers provide a tutorial. We recommend reading it carefully.

**Q: Something is broken, or you should add something!**
**A:** Contact us! You can send an email to [here](mailto:2488464442@qq.com).

**Q: What mods are included?**
**A:** Click on "Versions," select and click the version you want to download, then scroll down the page.

**Q: Does the server need to have this modpack too?**
**A:** No. You can join any vanilla server you want, just like in vanilla.

**Enjoy~**
(New project QAQ)


# 这里面有什么？

这是一个基于 **Neoforge** 实现的我的世界整合包。它的目标是在不改变游戏玩法的前提下增加一些使用的功能和优化。非常感谢那些优化模组（Sodium、Lithium、Ferritecore等）和功能模组（Chat Heads、Simple voice chat、No chat reports等）,这帮助了我（们）构建这份整合包！这个整合包尽可能地在兼容的前提下去使用这些模组。已在 Windows 设备上测试并且运行得不错（后续测试结果也很快会来）。

## 令人熟悉的体验

在几乎不修改原版功能的前提下实现的修改，意味着你即便没玩过这个整合包也可以轻易上手，就和之前一样。

## 原版兼容性

想和还在用原版的好友一起玩？别急，无需 TA 安装一样的整合包即可联机，无论是服务器还是局域网联机，依然有几乎不变的整合包功能。

## 更新安全

我（们）的整合包更新了内部提供的模组也可以正常使用，无需担心更新后会导致游戏损坏！

## 基于 Neoforge

这个整合包基于 **Neoforge**，一个流行的模组加载器，兼顾性能优化和玩法新颖的特点。你可以在里面加入你自己的模组去使用！

## 开放的开发

我（们）的开发过程需要各位的建议和支持，你的意见是我（们）开发的动力。如果遇到任何想要我（们）解决的问题，欢迎来联系我。

---

## Q&A

**Q: 我要如何下载、安装和运行它？**  
A: 一般的启动器都会给你一份教程，建议去仔细阅读。

**Q: 有东西出问题了或者你应该加点什么！**  
A: 尽管联系我（们）！你可以发邮件到[这里](mailto:2488464442@qq.com)

**Q: 里面有什么模组？**  
A: 点击 "Versions"，选择并点击一个你要下载的版本，随后向下滚动网页即可。

**Q: 服务器也需要有这个整合包吗？**  
A: 不需要。你可以像原版一样联机任何你想要的原版服务器。

**Enjoy~**
(新项目，不喜勿喷QAQ)
